title: Ocean Fish Match
description: Dive into a vibrant coral reef aquarium to match charming tropical sea tiles, unleash bubble boosters, and climb through relaxing underwater stages.
controls: Tap Start to dive in, then match identical underwater sea creatures and tiles to clear each coral reef stage.

zh-CN.title: 萌鱼海洋消除
zh-CN.description: 蔚蓝海底珊瑚礁主题消除：伴随灵动可爱的卡通热带鱼群，连消海洋元素触发炫彩泡泡特效，轻松闯关。
zh-CN.controls: 点击开始游戏进入海底关卡，点击或滑动匹配相同海洋图案完成每关消除目标。
